newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Brew unit sees loss from Foster's share sale.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Brew unit sees loss from Foster's share sale.

text.p: Asahi Breweries Ltd said on Friday that its wholly owned unit in Australia expects a loss of A$216.24 million from its sale of shares in Foster's Brewing Group Ltd.
Asahi Breweries said in a statement that it would maintain its earnings forecast despite the stock sale loss by Asahi Beer International Holding (Australia) Ltd.
The Australian unit will sell back 254.45 million Foster's shares to Foster's on July 31 for a total of A$625 million, Asahi Breweries said.
An Asahi Breweries spokesman later said in clarification that the company maintained its parent earnings forecast.

"We are now studying the impact of the unit's share sale on our group earnings. We will make an announcement on our group earnings forecast if we need to do so," the spokesman said without elaborating.
In February, Asahi announced that its parent current profit for the year to December 31, 1997, would be 30 billion yen, against 25.72 billion yen a year ago.
Asahi said in March it expected group net profit of 10 billion yen for 1997 business year against 8.23 billion yen in 1996.
